_doc: Proposed curated common names per fish species (1 to 3), for Pierre to confirm: tools/fish_common.py, docs/FISH_PATH.md "Common names". from: pdf = IMR reference PDF (fish.json common), dauin = circle 3's source name, fbMain = FishBase main English name, fbN = FishBase English records of the name (countries / references), inatMain = iNaturalist default English name, inat = another iNaturalist English name.
